description: Agent Automotive: submit a recall completion record with the open recall list as provided: the completion record with the VIN, the dealer and each completion with its id, campaign identifier, component and day completed; the open recall list with the VIN, the day it was drawn and each recall it shows open with its campaign identifier, the component it covers, the day it opened and the day a remedy became available. The signed report gives the record and the list, the VIN on each, each completion matched to its campaign, the campaigns the list does not show, the components completed otherwise, the completions dated before their recall opened or their remedy became available or before the list was drawn, the recalls left open and the campaigns completed twice, and counts them, and names a mismatched record: another VIN, a completion for a campaign the open recall list does not show, a completion for another component than its campaign covers, and a completion dated before its recall opened or its remedy became available; then a listed recall with no completion, a completion dated before the list that still shows it open and a campaign completed twice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No VIN on either side, a completion with no date, or two empty lists leaves the record unverified. Campaign identifiers match by their letters and digits, so 24V-123 and 24V123 read as one. This reads recall campaigns completed for one VIN: wever_commitment-closure-check reads the commitments an agent marked done against their closure evidence, and wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against warranty terms, while the recall check reads campaign completions against the recalls the list shows open. Verdict auto_recall_mismatched, auto_recall_partial, auto_recall_unverified or auto_recall_matched. POST /api/auto-recall-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

as_of.description: The day the list was drawn, such as 2026-06-12.

recalls.description: Each recall the list shows open for the vehicle.

remedy_on.description: The day a remedy became available, such as 2026-06-12.
